decision.reason: [ev-9761b3519d5c] says only that a new pattern variable %SERVICE_NAME% was added "for stat prefix". It does not name the configuration field or API that accepts the stat-prefix pattern, what the variable expands to, or which proxies or listeners use it. The other items in the telemetry section ([ev-d0208f15e021] through [ev-7e3267b542c5]) are separate changes and add nothing about this one. To write the subject, change and applicability aspects, we need the referenced PR or the matching config/API documentation (e.g. the field that defines the stat-prefix format).
